inst_r1_inconsistency.holm_sensitivity: Do not cite Inst improve-side effects as Holm-significant under the frozen 5-component family. Point estimates remain mixed.
inst_r1_inconsistency.numeric_basis: Inst Gen2 has mixed directions. Under R3 Inst-only Holm (m=1), SensorScope Delta_group improve and U-Air Delta_c_s improve are Holm-significant. Under the frozen 5-component Holm family rebuilt from 240 cells, those improve-side Holm p-values rise to ~0.0515 (not significant), while SensorScope Delta_c_s worsen and U-Air RMSE/Tail worsen remain Holm-significant. Paper-facing label remains ENDPOINT_TRADEOFF (claim ceiling C8 + cross-endpoint significant worsen).
